_about: The Monte Carlo of lines 2.8 (build) and 4.7 (test): `runs` reshuffled histories of a table. Each run draws as many whole days as the range has, with replacement, and uses the same days for every variant (so the table keeps its own co-movement). `seed` is fixed: every table is reshuffled with the same draws, so a number can be reproduced and two rounds can be compared (it is the seed of out/blueprint/funnel.py and mc_gates.py). `build.need` and `test.need` repeat rules.json 2.8 and 4.7; rules.py refuses to load when they differ. `text` is quoted from BLUEPRINT.md. `eval_card` = the Monte Carlo table of the eval card (line 6.4; blueprint/evalcard.py): the same `runs` and `seed`, whole days of ONE variant's test-period trades drawn with replacement until the last read (40 trades) is reached; `percentiles` = the columns of its drawdown and P&L tables (the cut and pause percentiles of rules.json 6.4 must be among them).
text: Reshuffled runs = 1,000 Monte Carlo histories: whole days drawn with replacement, the same days for every variant.
